# The hf CLI hf_cache_differential.yml compares Spice's Hugging Face cache with.
#
# Every package and dependency at an exact version, with the SHA-256 of each file PyPI serves
# for it, installed as
#   "$RUNNER_TEMP/hf-cli/bin/python" -m pip install --require-hashes --only-binary=:all: -r .github/requirements/hf_cli.txt
# so pip installs these files and nothing else. To change it, regenerate the whole file:
#   printf 'huggingface_hub==2.2.0\n' | uv pip compile - --universal --generate-hashes --no-header \
#     --no-annotate --python-version 3.12 --exclude-newer <a date two weeks back>
# (--exclude-newer keeps each dependency to a release at least two weeks old.)
